## Overview

This Adapter Validation Suite (AVS) instantiates the [UIAO_121 Adapter Conformance Test Plan](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/specs/adapter-conformance-test-plan-template.md) for the `defender-for-cloud-apps` adapter. It defines the Tier-1 contract-conformance criteria, the controls under validation, and the integration test plan that govern the adapter across its lifecycle.

## Validation status

**Reserved slot — not yet implemented.** `defender-for-cloud-apps` is `status: reserved` / `phase: phase-planning` in canon. No adapter code exists yet. The Tier-1 criteria below define the conformance gate the adapter **must** clear at activation; they are a forward-looking plan, not a current result.

## Scope

Target surfaces / subsystems: `shadow-it-discovery`, `oauth-app-inventory`, `app-risk-scoring`, `session-analytics`

**Validation artifacts:** `mcas-discovery-findings.json`, `mcas-oauth-inventory.json`, `mcas-risk-scores.json`

The suite validates that, for each target surface, the adapter normalizes vendor data into canonical claims, emits deterministic provenance, and produces KSI-anchored evidence — without mutating any source system (`ssot-mutation: never`).

## Controls under validation

The control roles below are mirrored from the adapter's companion [Adapter Technical Specification](../../../adapter-specs/defender-for-cloud-apps/defender-for-cloud-apps.html); the validation suite verifies that the adapter produces the evidence each role asserts.

NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls this adapter supports: `AC-2`, `AC-3`, `AC-6`, `AU-2`, `CA-7`

| Control | Role | Adapter capability |
|---|---|---|
| **AC-2** Account Management | Supporting | OAuth app inventory plus session analytics surface accounts whose access patterns warrant Access Review or de-provisioning. |
| **AC-3** Access Enforcement | Supporting | Session-level analytics observe access decisions made by upstream enforcement (Conditional Access, Conditional Access App Control); the adapter does not enforce. |
| **AC-6** Least Privilege | Primary | OAuth app inventory + app risk scoring identify over-permissioned third-party app consents — the canonical observation feed for least-privilege review of SaaS access. |
| **AU-2** Event Logging | Primary | Session-level event ingestion is the canonical observation feed for SaaS audit events that don't appear in tenant audit logs. |
| **CA-7** Continuous Monitoring | Primary | Scheduled telemetry collection provides continuous SaaS posture evidence with the freshness-window semantics defined in canon. |

## Notes from canon

Reserved slot per ADR-049. Read-only telemetry side of the Defender for Cloud Apps surface — Shadow IT discovery, OAuth app inventory, app risk scoring, session analytics. Pairs with `defender-for-cloud-apps-actions` (modernization-registry) for the change-making OAuth governance / session control side. Per ADR-049 §Decision 1, the dual-axis split is justified by ODA-15 (modernization = change-making).
